name: Corporate Action Narrative 56
definition: Provides additional information such as the taxation conditions.

AdditionalText.name: Additional Text
AdditionalText.definition: Provides additional information or specifies in more detail the content of a message. This field may only be used when the information to be transmitted, cannot be coded.

NarrativeVersion.name: Narrative Version
NarrativeVersion.definition: Provides information that can be ignored for automated processing; - reiteration of information that has been included within structured fields of this message, - or narrative information not needed for automatic processing.

InformationConditions.name: Information Conditions
InformationConditions.definition: Provides conditional information related to the event, for example, an offer is subject to 50 percent acceptance, the offeror allows the securities holder to set some conditions.

InformationToComplyWith.name: Information To Comply With
InformationToComplyWith.definition: Provides information conditions to the account owner that are to be complied with, for example, not open to US/Canadian residents, Qualified Institutional Buyers (QIB) or SIL (Sophisticated Investor Letter) to be provided.

TaxationConditions.name: Taxation Conditions
TaxationConditions.definition: Provides taxation conditions that cannot be included within the structured fields of this message and has not been mentioned in the Service Level Agreement (SLA).

Disclaimer.name: Disclaimer
Disclaimer.definition: Provides a disclaimer relative to the information provided in the message. It may be ignored for automated processing.

PartyContactNarrative.name: Party Contact Narrative
PartyContactNarrative.definition: Provides additional information regarding the party, for example, the contact unit or person responsible for the transaction identified in the message.

RegistrationDetails.name: Registration Details
RegistrationDetails.definition: Provides information required for the registration.

BasketOrIndexInformation.name: Basket Or Index Information
BasketOrIndexInformation.definition: Provides additional information on the basket or index underlying a security, for example a warrant.

CertificationBreakdown.name: Certification Breakdown
CertificationBreakdown.definition: Provides additional information about the type of certification/breakdown required.

ProcessingTextForNextIntermediary.name: Processing Text For Next Intermediary
ProcessingTextForNextIntermediary.definition: Provides additional information from the account servicer or a service provider solely intended for the next immediate account holder to enable or facilitate event processing between parties.

AdditionalInformationRule.definition: The AdditionalInformation field in all elements must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field unless bilaterally agreed or advised differently in the element definition as in NarrativeVersion.
